quests.hint: Try shifting the stress between 'I', 'never', and 'lazy'.
quests.explanation: Try stressing different words here — stressing 'I' implies someone else said it; stressing 'lazy' implies a different word was used.
quests.textToSpeak: I never said you were lazy.
quests.phoneticHint: Stress 'I' (denying who said it), 'never' (denying it happened), or 'lazy' (denying that word).

quests.hint: Try shifting the stress between 'I', 'never', and 'failed'.
quests.explanation: This sentence can mean different things depending on which word you stress — experiment with the emphasis.
quests.textToSpeak: I never said she failed the exam.
quests.phoneticHint: Stress 'I', 'never', or 'failed' — each shifts what exactly you're denying.

quests.hint: Try shifting the stress between 'I', 'never', and 'missed'.

quests.hint: Exaggerate the pitch on 'great' to signal you mean the opposite.
quests.explanation: Say the positive word with exaggerated, sing-song pitch — that's the tell that you mean the opposite.
quests.textToSpeak: Oh, great, another rainy Monday morning.
quests.phoneticHint: Swoop your pitch dramatically on 'great', then flatten for 'rainy Monday morning'.

quests.hint: Exaggerate the pitch on 'wonderful' to signal you mean the opposite.
quests.explanation: Stretch and exaggerate the pitch on the 'positive' word — real enthusiasm sounds different from sarcasm.
quests.textToSpeak: Oh, wonderful, another surprise pop quiz.
quests.phoneticHint: Swoop your pitch dramatically on 'wonderful', then flatten for the bad news.

quests.hint: Exaggerate the pitch on 'perfect' to signal you mean the opposite.
quests.explanation: The over-the-top pitch on the first word signals irony — you clearly don't mean it sincerely.
quests.textToSpeak: Oh, perfect, the printer is broken again.
quests.phoneticHint: Swoop your pitch dramatically on 'perfect', then flatten for the bad news.

quests.hint: Exaggerate the pitch on 'lovely' to signal you mean the opposite.
quests.explanation: Give the positive word a theatrical, exaggerated rise — that's what makes the sarcasm unmistakable.
quests.textToSpeak: Oh, lovely, our flight got delayed again.
quests.phoneticHint: Swoop your pitch dramatically on 'lovely', then flatten for the bad news.

quests.hint: Exaggerate the pitch on 'fantastic' to signal you mean the opposite.

quests.phoneticHint: Swoop your pitch dramatically on 'fantastic', then flatten for the bad news.

quests.hint: Exaggerate the pitch on 'terrific' to signal you mean the opposite.

quests.hint: Exaggerate the pitch on 'delicious' to signal you mean the opposite.

quests.hint: Exaggerate the pitch on 'brilliant' to signal you mean the opposite.
